title: Thai Paella with Chewy Spanish Sausage
description: A unique fusion of Spanish and Thai flavors in a savory paella dish.
instructions: Heat oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add rice and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add vegetable broth, fish sauce, lemon juice, chili flakes, and sugar. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes or until rice is cooked.
Stir in parmesan cheese and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.

Note: Traditionally, paella is cooked over an open flame, which gives the rice a crispy crust at the bottom called the socarrat. If you have access to an outdoor grill or a stovetop with a large burner, you can achieve this same effect.
